content: STAGE 1 — ORIENTATION. Goal: see what reference material exists in the session workspace before proposing. Read: directory listing of the agent working dir. Observed: (pending). Open: whether SID table / Issue #126 reference files are readable, and what HBAA and the failed metrics actually consume.

STAGE 2 — ACCESS CHECK. Goal: read the SID tables / Issue #126 reference to ground the formula in real arrays. Read: glob over the issue126 results tree, and a browser tab listing. Observed: filesystem outside the agent working dir is permission-denied (external_directory), and no desktop browser is connected; the agent dir appears to be empty of inputs. Conclusion: metric must be specified symbolically, not fitted/verified here. Open: nothing blocking; the formula must be exactly implementable from the stated arrays.

STAGE 3 — FINAL ANSWER recorded (summary; full block printed in the reply). Goal: one hyperbolic SID-table metric distinct from HBAA/Q_H/covering-radius/path-likelihood/cell-rank-lift. Read: the contract, the 97-pair results, the worked+failed metric list. Observed: the unclaimed design-space region is the IDEAL BOUNDARY (horospheres / Busemann functions); every measured metric lives in the interior of the ball and uses lengths, barycentres or tangent inner products. Proposed METRIC horo_cell_rank: (1) per-item query direction xi_i = b_i/||b_i|| where b_i is the Karcher barycentre of the FULL training predecessor set Pred(i) of item i; (2) level-1 cell representatives m_a = Karcher barycentre of the target representations of the cell's training members; (3) horospherical height B(x;xi)=log((1-||x||^2)/||x-xi||^2), curvature K=-1 fixed; (4) r_i = 1/2 + sum_a n_a*sigmoid((H_i(a)-H_i(code1(i)))/tau) over all 256 cells weighted by true size, tau = 1.4826*MAD of the pooled heights (derived, not tuned); metric = 1 - 2*mean_i((r_i-1/2)/(N-1)). Adds over Q_H/HBAA: whole-history query point rather than one pair, radius-aware height (conformal factor) rather than raw alignment/distance, full negative distribution rather than a 10-negative mean, and collapse scores exactly 0 by construction so no size-matched null is needed. Cost ~10-25 s at 24587 x 256 x d. Failure mode: a radially stratified table (codes assigned by norm shell) -> all heights equal -> 0. Open: no numeric verification possible (filesystem outside the agent dir is permission-denied, no browser), so the formula is specified symbolically and exactly for the evaluator.
